regimeSub: Trump tariff/sanction lift + Warsh rate signal fade eases pressure as tech carnage extends and oil holds $108.
themes: Trump Oct 17 tariff/sanctions rollback per Reuters triggers risk relief → SPX -1.1% to 7659 but DXY -0.5% to 101.86; USDKRW -1% to 1332 as trade fears ease despite Sep CPI 4.0% YoY overhang
Warsh Oct 15-16 'price stability key but no rate signal' per PBS/CNBC → rate hike bets fade per BigGo Finance Oct 19; 2Y -5bp to 4.77% as Oct hike odds reprice lower despite 3.0% core PCE

Samsung/SK Hynix 'peak-out' contagion per BigGo Finance Oct 15 drags KOSPI -0.6% to 5685 → BOK Gov Shin Oct 12 hawkish split keeps Nov hike live; President's Oct 13 'unavoidable' hike comment politicizes policy
Treasury rally extends as 10Y -9bp to 5.10% on flight-to-quality per Bloomberg Oct 15 → gold -0.1% to $4196 consolidates near highs; Brent +2.5% to $108 as Saudi-Iran supply disruptions persist

headline: Trump tariff/sanctions rollback and Warsh's refusal to signal October hike ease stagflation pressure, but SPX slides 1.1% as tech carnage extends with semis questioning AI capex cycle while Brent holds $108 on Gulf supply risks.
